description: This file defines a label selector system in Go, including interfaces, data structures, parsing logic, and utility functions for handling label selection criteria in Kubernetes-related code.

classes.name: Requirements
classes.description: Type alias for a slice of Requirement, representing combined label requirements.

classes.name: Selector
classes.description: Interface defining methods for label selection, including matching, copying, and requirement management.

classes.name: nothingSelector
classes.description: Implementation of Selector that matches no labels.

classes.name: internalSelector
classes.description: Type alias for a slice of Requirement, implementing the Selector interface.

classes.name: Requirement
classes.description: Struct representing a label requirement with key, operator, and values.

methods.name: Everything
methods.description: Returns a Selector that matches all labels.

methods.name: Nothing
methods.description: Returns a Selector that matches no labels.

methods.name: SelectorFromSet
methods.description: Returns a Selector matching exactly the given set of labels.

methods.name: ValidatedSelectorFromSet
methods.description: Returns a validated Selector matching the given set of labels.

methods.name: SelectorFromValidatedSet
methods.description: Returns a Selector from a validated set of labels.

methods.name: ParseToRequirements
methods.description: Parses a selector string into a list of Requirement objects.
